meta.note: Every fee, tier and KYC fact below was checked against a live program page, a live submission form, or a first-hand hunt by the maintainer. Entries carry their verification date; data older than 30 days is flagged STALE by the evaluator. Always re-check the live form before filing — fees change.

programs.fee_notes: No submission fee found on the program page.
programs.name: Aave
programs.notes: Aave v2 on Ethereum is Critical/High-only; v3, GHO and governance pay all tiers. Low flat $1,000. Immunefi requires a VERIFIED account to file (Gitcoin Passport score >=25 or 100 credits) — an unverified account cannot submit.
programs.source: Immunefi program page, checked during a first-hand hunt

programs.fee_notes: Reports by GitHub private advisory or email; no submission fee.
programs.name: FLOP Network
programs.notes: NO bug bounty program ('no bug bounty program at this time', SECURITY.md). Reports get a technical response + public credit; a discretionary reward from the ecosystem reserve is possible but not guaranteed. Ack in 3 business days, assessment in 14 days. Never file an exploitable finding as a public issue.
programs.source: flop-labs/yellowpaper SECURITY.md + airdrop page, checked live 21 Nov 2026
